name: IP concept directions
description: Generate distinct visual directions from an approved character bible and declared references.
instructionTemplate: Generate distinct IP character concept directions from the bound character bible. Treat the bible as the identity and design authority. Use each optional image only according to its declared reference intent. Explore materially different visual languages while preserving every immutable identity anchor. Do not merge references into an undeclared source image, silently change the audience or brand constraints, or select a winning direction.
outputRequirements: Return clean character concept image candidates only.
Return exactly one visual direction per output image. Never place multiple alternatives in one image, contact sheet, comparison board, collage, or grid.
Each candidate must preserve the fixed identity anchors and express a clearly distinct visual direction.
Keep the character readable as one consistent IP rather than producing unrelated characters.
Do not claim that any candidate is accepted or approved.

description.default: Explore distinct visual directions from the character bible.
